user.title: Connect SmartTherm
user.description: Enter your SmartTherm account user ID and existing token. The token is stored locally by Home Assistant. Use the numeric account ID, not an email address.

reauth_confirm.title: Replace SmartTherm token
reauth_confirm.description: The existing token was rejected. Enter a valid token for this account.

reconfigure.title: Replace SmartTherm token
reconfigure.description: Enter a replacement token for this account.

error.no_devices: No supported online thermostats (models 08/09) were found.

abort.already_configured: This SmartTherm account is already configured.
